description: This file defines a React component 'TableOfContents' that generates a dynamic table of contents based on document headings, utilizing IntersectionObserver to track visible headings and update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: Heading
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining the structure of heading objects used within the TableOfContents component.

methods.name: sortVisible
methods.description: Sorts an array of heading IDs to maintain their original document order, prioritizing the targetId.

methods.name: TableOfContents
methods.description: React functional component displaying a table of contents that highlights the currently visible section based on heading intersection status.
